adrs.text:
# Grandfather direct access from quote_service during the layer migration

* Status: Accepted
* Date: 2025-08-18

## Context and Problem Statement

Rule R004 forbids this access, but the data-access layer does not yet support streaming reads, and the proper layer will not be ready for some time.

## Decision Outcome

Until the layer migration completes, the quote service (`quote_service`) may continue to access the database connection module (`connection`) directly. Dependencies of this kind introduced on or before 2025-09-13 are grandfathered. Any such dependency introduced after 2025-09-13 is NOT covered by this decision and must be treated as a violation of R004.

### Consequences

Grandfathered dependencies must be removed when the migration finishes.
